business_scope.primary_industry_name: Interactive Audio Chatroom and Companion Social Applications

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Cross-Strait Economic Cooperation Framework Agreement (ECFA) and related SEF/ARATS agreements; these are not international BITs but provide the operative framework for trade, investment, IP cooperation, and dispute prevention between China and Taiwan.

No Bilateral Investment Treaty between the People's Republic of China and Taiwan exists under international law; investment protection is sourced from the Act for Governing Relations between the People of Taiwan and Mainland Areas, the Statute for Investment by Foreign Nationals as applied to mainland Chinese investors, and Investment Commission approvals.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Money Laundering Control Act of Taiwan, Articles 7 and 8 (customer due diligence and PEP obligations); Company Act of Taiwan, Articles 18 and 22-1 (name regulation and mandatory register of controlling shareholders/ultimate beneficial owners); Counter-Terrorism Funding Control Act; the Regulations Governing Company Name and Business Scope Pre-Approval; the Statute for Investment by Foreign Nationals; and cross-strict investment approval rules under the Act for Governing Relations between the People of Taiwan and Mainland Areas.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: PRC notarization, verification by the Straits Exchange Foundation (SEF), and consular legalization where required by the Taiwanese Investment Commission or local court; Hague Apostille is not available because Taiwan is not a party to the Hague Apostille Convention.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: PRC market regulator and PRC Notary Public Office
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: PRC notarization followed by SEF verification and, where required, authentication by the Taipei Economic and Cultural Office.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: PRC notarization and SEF verification; consular legalization if the Investment Commission so demands.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization in the place of issue and verification through SEF or TECO legalization; bank references must be recently dated.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: PRC notarization and SEF/TECO verification; if the power of attorney is signed in Taiwan, notarization in Taiwan is required.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized copy with SEF verification and TECO consular legalization where requested by Taiwanese banks or the Investment Commission.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, UBOs, and senior managers against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN and Non-SDN sanction lists, Taiwan’s domesticAML/CFT risk alerts, and Interpol/domestic enforcement citations. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory for all PEPs, including mainland Chinese PEPs, as well as for source-of-wealth and source-of-funds verification of the PRC shareholder. Given the ISIC 6311 voice-streaming companion social app model and reliance on Apple IAP and Google Play Billing, the entity is classified as Medium_Risk_Enhanced; no statutory license is required, but transaction monitoring and UBO refresh obligations will apply if the company later engages in fund transmission or virtual-asset services.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: 公司及商業一站式線上申請作業系統 (Company and Commercial One-Stop Online Application System), operated by the Department of Commercial Services, Ministry of Economic Affairs; name pre-approval section: 公司名稱及所營事業預查.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The official legal company name must be registered in Traditional Chinese characters. Latin letters, Arabic numerals, and certain permitted symbols may be appended, but the legal name remains the Chinese name. An English company name may be separately registered for foreign commercial use but does not replace the Chinese legal name. A mainland Chinese shareholder’s simplified-Chinese name and any pinyin transliteration must be converted to Traditional Chinese and to the orthographic standard accepted by the Ministry of Economic Affairs; the company name must not be identical to or confusingly similar to an existing Taiwanese company name in the same industry.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A rejected name pre-approval may be appealed by filing a written administrative appeal with the Ministry of Economic Affairs within 30 days of the written rejection decision, under the Administrative Procedure Act and the Company Name and Business Scope Pre-Approval Regulations. The applicant may also refile a new name immediately without prejudice. An approved name may be extended once, by applying before the six-month expiry, for an additional six-month period; if incorporation is not completed before the extended deadline, the reserved name will be released and full re-screening is required. For a mainland-Chinese-owned WFOE, the name application should be coordinated with the Investment Commission’s cross-strait investment approval timeline to avoid refusal or resubmission.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office is conditionally permitted for the registered address provided that a real Taiwanese street address is used, an identified local service agent can accept legal process and regulatory correspondence, and the company maintains verifiable local business records, financial books, and data-control records at a Taiwan location. A virtual office alone is insufficient to establish commercial substance for tax and AML/CFT purposes, especially under Investment Commission review of a mainland Chinese investor or if the FSC/MJIB scrutinizes payment activities through app-store channels.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low in the first year (estimated 10% to 15%), but rising to roughly 25% if the company applies for tax incentives, remits profits to the PRC shareholder, receives an investment audit, or becomes involved in a sanctioned transaction. Unannounced physical inspections may be carried out by the National Tax Administration or the Investigation Bureau under money-laundering control enforcement powers.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Act of Taiwan (2021 consolidated version), Articles 1, 6, 15-18, 29-34, 98-114, 128-153; Foreign Investment Act, Article 7 (investment approval)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Department of Commercial Services, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Taiwan
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Company Registration (公司登記申請書) accompanied by the Articles of Incorporation (公司章程)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for a limited company under the Company Act; however, the Investment Commission must approve the foreign-invested capital amount as sufficient for the business plan, and paid-in capital must be deposited in a local bank account before registration. No escrow account requirement is imposed.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Company has subscribed to 100 ordinary shares of industrial par value NTD 10 per share at par, totaling NTD 1,000,000, payable in cash, and approves the detailed share allotment as recorded in the books. RESOLVED, that the registered office be fixed at the address listed on the Articles of Incorporation, effective immediately. RESOLVED, that the following officers are duly appointed: [Director/General Manager/CFO], each to serve at the pleasure of the Board and to perform duties as circumscribed by law and these minutes. ALL actions necessary shall be filed with MOEA.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign Investment Approval and Name Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs; Taiwan Business Info (twin.com.tw portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the foreign investment application online via MOEA Investment Commission, including shareholder identification, capital structure, business plan, and a description of the voice streaming service. Simultaneously apply for company name and business scope pre-approval through the MOEA registration system to secure the reserved legal name for 6 months.
required_dossiers: Foreign investor passport/certificate of incorporation (notarized and apostilled/legalized)
Power of attorney to local representative (notarized)
Proposed company name and business scope
Detailed business plan and funding explanation
Capital funding source proof (bank statement)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the MOEA issues a query or objection, respond in writing within 7 business days with corrected information; any rejection may be appealed to the Administrative Appeals Commission or resubmitted once the specified capital adequacy or scope clarification is provided.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Articles of Incorporation and Shareholder Consent
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public or certified attorney; in practice the MOEA accepts corporate chop and signatures
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation in Chinese covering company name, business scope, registered office address, share capital structure, shareholder list, board of directors and supervisors (or designated director for a single-member WFOE), and meeting procedures. Have all shareholders and initial directors execute the Articles and record the first board resolution in the meeting minutes.
required_dossiers: Articles of Incorporation executed by all shareholders
First board resolution minutes (signed by director)
Shareholders' consent for initial share subscription
List of initial directors and supervisors (if any)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If execution formalities are incomplete, re-execute with amended signatures and obtain a fresh notarization; ensure all corporate seals are registered under the exact legal name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening Bank Account and Deposit of Paid-Up Capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary corporate bank account using the pre-registered company name and prospective articles. Deposit the agreed paid-up capital (e.g., NTD 1,000,000) and obtain a deposit certificate and bank-clearance proof to present at company registration.
required_dossiers: Company name reservation certificate
Articles of Incorporation (draft)
Bank account opening form for a non-registered company (pre-registration)
Passport or company charters of foreign shareholders
Proof of capital remittance (FOREX certificate)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses to open a pre-registration account, the foreign shareholder may remit funds only after the company is provisionally registered; alternatively, use a local attorney account as escrow and later transfer the marked capital to the corporate account.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing for Company Registration with MOEA
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Commercial Services, Ministry of Economic Affairs (online filing via 'Company Registration Portal')
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the complete application pack electronically or in person, including the foreign investment approval letter, Articles of Incorporation, first board resolution, bank deposit certificate, and addresses for the registered office. Pay the registration fee and obtain the company incorporation certificate.
required_dossiers: Foreign investment approval letter from the Investment Commission
Application for Company Registration
Articles of Incorporation and the first board resolution minutes
Bank deposit certificate (capital proof)
Registered office lease or proof of ownership
Name reservation certificate
Corporate seal registration form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MOEA queries the entry, correct inaccuracies within 15 days; a rejection can be remedied by filing an administrative appeal or re-filing after rectifying the registered office/lease or capital deposit issues; retroactive tax registration is to be completed immediately after issuance.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Tax, Labor, and Operational Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Regional National Taxation Bureau (Ministry of Finance); Bureau of Labor Insurance and Work Security
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Automatically register the company for profit-enterprise income tax (by incorporation record), for value-added tax (if turnover threshold met), for work safety and health insurance, for labor pension, and for unemployment insurance. Obtain a Uniform Invoice Number (統一編號) and apply for any required class-3 import/export license if ancillary e-commerce physical goods are transacted.
required_dossiers: Incorporation certificate from MOEA
Registered office lease and contract
Qualification of accounting records
List of employees (initial”)
Bank confirmation of office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Failure to register for labor insurance within the statutory deadline triggers a fine and may be cured by backdated registration; VAT registration is required only after actual turnover begins, so an immediate registration is advisory.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (STA); administered locally by the municipal/state-level STA service bureaus where the WFOE is domiciled; digital platform: National E-Tax Bureau (etax.chinatax.gov.cn) and the state unified VAT invoice management system.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A PRC WFOE is automatically enrolled in tax registration upon incorporation under the multi-certificate integration system: the 18-digit Unified Social Credit Code (USCC) printed on the business license is the statutory TIN and VAT registration number. Within 30 days of business-license issuance, the WFOE must complete post-registration formalities at the competent STA local bureau: (i) real-name authentication of the legal representative and financial officer; (ii) filing of accounting/bookkeeping standards; (iii) tax-item identification covering Corporate Income Tax, VAT, urban maintenance and construction tax, education surcharges, stamp duty, and other local levies; (iv) invoice type and monthly issuance quota approval; and (v) confirmation of the electronic tax registration record. A foreign-incorporated parent investor (including a Taiwan resident corporate investor) without a Chinese establishment must separately obtain a non-resident tax registration code for China-source income withholding and filing purposes; because the 2015 Cross-Strait Taxation Arrangement is signed but not yet in force, Taiwan investors currently rely on the domestic 10% withholding framework rather than treaty rate relief.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: China does not provide a US-style check-the-box entity classification election. The WFOE is mandatorily a PRC tax resident enterprise taxed at entity level on worldwide income at 25%. Available statutory elections include: (i) VAT small-scale taxpayer status where annual taxable sales do not exceed RMB 5,000,000, with a simplified 3% levy rate (temporarily 1% under Caishui [2023] No. 19), versus mandatory general taxpayer registration once annual taxable sales exceed RMB 5,000,000; (ii) simplified VAT computation election for enumerated supplies; (iii) tax-free reorganization or deferred-recognition elections for qualifying asset restructurings under Caishui [2009] No. 59; (iv) deemed-profit taxation only upon STA approval where books cannot be audited; and (v) beneficial-ownership documentation filings by non-resident investors to claim reduced withholding rates where an effective treaty applies. Hybrid mismatch elections are not available; thin capitalization, CFC, and general anti-abuse rules neutralize hybrid arrangements.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (value-added tax on goods and services, integrating the former business tax regime since 2016; cross-border supplies are subject to PRC territorial-source consumption rules under Caishui [2016] No. 36).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No turnover threshold applies to a newly incorporated WFOE; VAT registration is mandatory upon establishment for all limited liability enterprises. The small-scale taxpayer regime applies where annual taxable sales do not exceed RMB 5,000,000; once annual taxable sales exceed RMB 5,000,000, the WFOE must register as a VAT general taxpayer. The voice-streaming information service revenue is chargeable at 6% VAT, while the statutory headline/goods rate is 13% and the cross-border export rate is 0%.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Golden Tax Phase IV and the fully digital e-invoice regime apply: invoices must be issued through the unified E-Tax Bureau platform with real-time data upload, centralized tax-control encryption, and automatic digital stamping at the moment of issuance. VAT taxpayers must use STA-approved API or browser-based invoicing modules, obtain issuance quotas before invoicing, and support real-time reconciliation and red-letter reversal workflows. Paper invoices are retained only in transitional cases; cross-border invoices and zero-rated supply documentation must be electronically archived and made available to STA inspection.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods exports qualify for the 0% VAT rate with input-tax refund where a customs export declaration is filed. Cross-border services qualify for zero-rating or VAT exemption only for enumerated offshore services wholly consumed outside China, such as software services, information-system services, offshore outsourcing, R&D, design, and technology transfer, per Caishui [2016] No. 36 Annex 4. The voice-streaming/interactive-audio platform may claim zero-rating or exemption only where the service recipient is a registered overseas enterprise (for example Apple or Google as app-store operators), the service is fully consumed outside mainland China, the invoice is issued to the overseas counterparty, and consideration is received in foreign exchange from abroad. The WFOE must complete the export VAT filing and offshore-service exemption/zero-rating record-filing with STA before the first qualifying supply; sales to PRC users through App Store or Google Play channels remain within domestic VAT territorial scope and cannot be zero-rated.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (for physical goods) or the approved cross-border service zero-rating/exemption filing record
Bill of Lading or airway bill, supplemented for services by electronic delivery logs evidencing offshore consumption
Inward Remittance Certificate (bank foreign-exchange receipt voucher) proving collection from the overseas counterparty
Cross-border service contract and tax-compliant invoice issued to the overseas customer
Offshore consumption evidence, including subscriber residency data, server logs, and records showing the services and intellectual property are used entirely outside mainland China
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: STA audit review may retrospectively claw back refunded VAT with daily late-payment surcharges (0.05% per day on the underpaid tax) and impose administrative penalties of 50% to five times the amount of tax evaded or fraudulently refunded under Tax Collection Law Articles 63 and 64. Export-refund qualification may be suspended for up to three years, and previously refunded input VAT is reversed. Fraudulent export-refund claims constitute a criminal offense under Criminal Law Article 204, punishable by imprisonment up to life and confiscation of property where the sums are huge. Responsible officers face personal liability, travel and payment restrictions, credit blacklisting, and an extended retrospective audit window of up to ten years in cases involving fraudulent intent.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) within the People's Bank of China (PBOC) system is the controlling foreign-exchange regulator for the PRC WFOE. PBOC sets RMB monetary policy and exchange-rate management policy; SAFE administers foreign-exchange receipts and payments, current-account verification, capital-account registration, and all cross-border banking supervision. The Taiwan parent company is separately regulated by Taiwan's Investment Commission (Ministry of Economic Affairs) for making permitted outbound investments into mainland China.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The RMB is fully convertible for current-account purposes once a bank has performed statutory verification; this includes trade in services, software/app-store revenue, royalties, salaries, and profit remittances. For the WFOE, after-tax profits and legitimate dividends may be remitted to the Taiwan shareholder without prior SAFE approval, but only after submission of the board dividend resolution, audited annual financial statements, tax clearance certification, stamp tax payment evidence, and bank-side construction of a current-account profit-remittance file. Capital-account transactions remain controlled: FDI equity injections require an FDI registration number and can be received only into a bank-designated Foreign Exchange Capital Account; use of converted RMB capital is restricted by SAFE's negative list, which prohibits use for securities investment, entrusted loans, repayment of unrelated external debt, or speculative property purchase. The WFOE must maintain a clear separation between capital-account proceeds and current-account operating-fund flows.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Since the 2009-2012 SAFE reforms, there is no mandatory surrender ratio for export receipts in foreign currency; the mandatory conversion ratio is zero. For physical goods exports, export proceeds must be repatriated to a domestic foreign-currency settlement account within the normal trade credit period recorded in the sales contract, ordinarily within 90 days after the export customs declaration; any longer deferral must be registered in SAFE's trade-monitoring system. Once repatriated, the WFOE may retain 100% of the foreign exchange in its settlement account or sell it to a licensed bank at its own discretion. For the digital service revenue receivable from Apple and Google, the flows are current-account service export receipts; they must be received through the WFOE's onshore foreign-currency settlement account, declared through the bank's digital service-trade verification system, and supported by app-store settlement statements; no surrender percentage applies.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: FDI Foreign Exchange Capital Account, RMB Basic Deposit Account, and Foreign Currency Current Account for app-store proceeds

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: RMB Basic Deposit Account and Foreign Exchange Settlement Account
FDI Foreign Exchange Capital Account and RMB General Deposit Account with integrated cross-border treasury product
RMB Basic Deposit Account and Foreign Exchange Settlement Account
RMB Basic Deposit Account and Foreign Exchange Settlement Account with cross-border payment handling

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: Low for the PRC-regulated core treasury. Offshore digital EMIs such as Wise Business, Airwallex, Currenxie, or Revolut Business cannot open a PBOC-recognised RMB basic deposit account, cannot hold the SAFE-registered FDI capital-account funds, and cannot make SAFE declarations on behalf of the PRC WFOE. An EMI may be used only as an auxiliary receivable wallet operated by the Taiwan parent outside China; directing app-store proceeds through an offshore EMI before repatriation would create a non-compliant detour around SAFE bank-side verification and would undermine the WFOE's audit trail and AML profile. All onshore operating funds and capital injections must clear to a licensed onshore commercial bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote-only corporate account opening is not permitted by PBOC for an RMB Basic Deposit Account, and no bank will open a SAFE-administered FDI Foreign Exchange Capital Account without physical attendance. The legal representative, or a senior officer holding a notarized power of attorney in Chinese, must appear in person at the selected branch to execute account documents, present corporate chops, and complete the verification interview. Non-resident Taiwan directors and beneficial owners do not all need to travel; their identities may be verified through video supplements, but the on-site person remains mandatory. The Taiwan corporate shareholder must deliver notarized or original copies of its incorporation certificate, board resolution for the WFOE investment, shareholder register, beneficial-ownership declaration, and valid travel documents. Any mismatch between the PRC business-license name in Chinese and the English bank instruction will cause rejection.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Digital-content business with no physical goods, high volume of in-app micro-transactions routed through Apple/Google, and the Medium_Risk_Enhanced AML classification of the RAZER/voice-social segment.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: PRC business license with Unified Social Credit Code; ISIC 6311 and NAICS 519130 industry mapping; executed Apple Developer Program License Agreement and Google Play Distribution Agreement; recent app-store payout statements; audited revenue-recognition policy; physical head-office lease; payroll records; flow diagram showing app stores as direct counterparties; AML policy for virtual gifting and tipping; complete audit trail linking every in-app purchase to platform settlement reports.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident Taiwanese ultimate beneficial owners and a corporate shareholder outside mainland China, creating shell-company and concealment concerns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized Taiwan parent incorporation certificate and current shareholders' register; certified beneficial-ownership declaration; board resolution approving the WFOE's registered capital; director passports and Taiwan ID cards; bank reference letters from the Taiwan remitting bank; PRC company-chop certificate and legal-representative appointment; third-party background checks on every holder of a 5-percent-or-greater interest.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large or clustered inbound FDI capital injection within a short period and limited operating history; disguised capital flow or round-tripping is suspected.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board-approved twelve-month cash-flow budget covering cloud infrastructure, content moderation, payroll, and app-store fees; source-of-funds statements from the Taiwan shareholder's bank account; Taiwan Investment Commission approval of the mainland investment; signed investment contract and capital-contribution timetable; anti-round-tripping declaration; certified opening balance sheet from the WFOE's auditor.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border related-party payments for software licensing, content royalties, and technical services may signal transfer-pricing manipulation or undeclared withholding tax.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Arm's-length written agreements with clear royalty calculations; OECD-compliant transfer-pricing local file and bench-marking study; SAFE contract-registration forms for intellectual-property and service imports; tax-bureau withholding certificates or non-withholding statements; detailed technical-services documentation; income-tax residence certificates of Taiwan recipients under the Cross-Strait Tax Agreement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mainland social-voice applications attract regulatory scrutiny over user-generated content, privacy, and data security; banks fear reputational contagion and hidden PRC license risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: PRC counsel legal opinion confirming the current voice-streaming scope does not require a statutory content or telecom license; Cybersecurity Law and Data Security Law filing or exemption evidence; privacy policy; user age-gating and content-moderation protocols; complaint and take-down records; data-localization and cross-border transfer impact analysis; appointment of a PRC data-security officer; terms of service prohibiting illicit content.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The WFOE must first engage its appointed bank as the FDI registration bank, which inputs the FDI basic information into the SAFE Digital Foreign Exchange Administration Platform and obtains the FDI registration code before any inward remittance is accepted. The Taiwan parent must obtain the required Taiwan Investment Commission approval and remit the capital contribution from its Taiwan bank in USD, HKD, or RMB. The MT103/MT202 wire must name the remitter as the Taiwan shareholder, the beneficiary exactly as the WFOE's licensed Chinese/English company name, and the beneficiary account as the specific FDI Foreign Exchange Capital Account. The remittance purpose must be stated as 'investment in registered capital' or '注册资本投资款' and must include the SAFE FDI registration code; generic purposes such as 'loan', 'business expense', or 'service fee' are rejected. The receiving bank verifies the entry against the SAFE registered capital amount, reports it under the capital-account class of FOREIGN-DIRECT-INVESTMENT EQUITY INJECTION, and then applies the RMB conversion under the capital-use negative list. If the Taiwan parent remits RMB, the payment must clear through a CIPS participant bank with RCPMIS reporting and the same FDI registration reference.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For service imports, software royalties, cloud-hosting fees, content-moderation contracts, and app-store platform fees, the primary clearing rail is an onshore-bank SWIFT MT103 from the WFOE's foreign-currency settlement account. The bank requires the underlying contract, a valid invoice, the SAFE service-trade transaction classification, and, where the payment is a China-sourced taxable item, the corresponding tax-withholding or non-tax filing certificate. For physical goods imports, such as branded merchandising hardware, the WFOE may use commercial letters of credit under ICC UCP600, documentary collection, or direct T/T, with customs entry papers and cargo inspection evidence. Profit remittances to the Taiwan shareholder are executed as MT103 dividends after audit, board approval, tax clearance, and current-account verification. For payments received from Apple and Google, settlement comes to the WFOE from the app stores as a current-account service receipt, not as consumer person-to-person transfer; the bank credits the foreign-currency account and completes service-trade digital declaration using app-store statements, tax invoices, and platform payout reports.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable RMB/USD and RMB/HKD forward contracts offered by PBOC/SAFE licensed onshore banks, supported by genuine app-store receivables and forecast royalty flows.
Cross-currency interest-rate swaps for long-term USD-denominated intercompany debt or capital-exposure management.
FX swaps between RMB and foreign currency for short-term liquidity smoothing of operating cash flow.
FX option and option-combination products sold by qualified PRC banks, provided the underlying exposure is real and the product passes suitability and real-trade-background checks.

NDF overlay: Onshore non-deliverable forwards are not a permissible hedging instrument for a PRC WFOE. Any offshore NDF overlay is restricted to the Taiwan parent's own treasury positions and must never be booked, funded, or settled through the PRC WFOE's banking rail.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Statements, Business Report, and Profit Appropriation or Loss Offsetting Proposal submitted to MOEA and kept at the registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Commercial Services and Company Registration Unit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year taxpayer not later than 30 June of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Company Act fine of NTD 10,000–50,000 on the responsible person; continued default may trigger MOEA compulsory strike-off after administrative order

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax Annual Return, including income reconciliation, balance sheet, and annual tax computation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Jurisdiction National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance, Taiwan
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual filing period from 1 May through 31 May; extended to 30 June for e-filing taxpayers with a calendar fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing surcharge of 10% of underpaid or undisclosed tax, monthly interest of 1%, enforced collection and tax lien actions; repeated non-filing may lead to suspension of tax clearance and MOEA deregistration

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Major Shareholder / Beneficial Ownership Declaration under Company Act Article 22-1
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs – Major Shareholder and Beneficial Owner Declaration Platform
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually from 1 March through 31 March; updates required within 15 days after any 10%-or-greater shareholding or beneficial-owner change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Company Act fine of NTD 50,000–500,000 for failure to file or for false declaration; persistent non-compliance may result in administrative strike-off / compulsory deregistration

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Taiwan company must undergo an independent CPA audit if its paid-in capital reaches NTD 30 million or more, if it is a public or institutional securities issuer, or if ordered by MOEA or the tax authority; otherwise, financial statements may be prepared by management and reviewed or reported by a CPA where required by lenders or counterparties.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as endorsed by the Taiwan Financial Supervisory Commission (TIFRS) for public companies; local statutory accounting principles under the Business Entity Accounting Act for non-public companies (with voluntary opt-in to TIFRS/IFRS).

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: For a Taiwan WFOE (non-public limited company), the annual major-shareholder and beneficial-owner confirmation is due by 31 March. Any shareholding transfer creating or extinguishing a 10%-or-greater shareholder or beneficial-owner interest must be reported through MOEA's Article 22-1 declaration system, including acquisition date and number of shares. Changes to directors and supervisors are separately updated through the ordinary company registration system within 15 days, and the Register of Members must be physically maintained and updated at the Taiwan registered office.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,000 - 5,000 per annum when statutory audit applies

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 20% (flat rate on taxable income exceeding NT$200,000; NT$120,000 exemption for taxable income not exceeding NT$120,000; partial exemption band NT$120,001–NT$200,000 taxed on 50% of the excess)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Standard effective rates: 0% up to NT$120,000 taxable income; 10% effective in the NT$120,001–NT$200,000 band; full 20% above NT$200,000. R&D investment credit of 15% under Article 10 of the Statute for Industrial Innovation (capped at 30% of the tax payable for small/medium-sized enterprises; available for app-development R&D in Taiwan). No general sectoral IT incentive applies to voice-streaming social apps.
